title: Trove photo
description: One line of photos/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: metadata for one photo/asset, never image bytes. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local capture time (photo taken / video recorded / screenshot saved)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (Apple Photos asset UUID, EXIF content hash, Google sidecar URL, Flickr/SmugMug image id, BeReal post id, screenshot content hash)

title.description: caption / title where the source has one (Google description, Flickr/SmugMug caption)

favorite.description: flagged a favorite / faved on the source

duration_secs.description: clip length, in seconds, for video / live assets

albums.description: album / set names this asset belongs to (verbatim)

tags.description: source-native tags / keywords (Flickr tags, SmugMug keywords, EXIF keywords)

people.description: face/person cluster ids or labels (opt-in; raw source handles, not resolved across sources)

people_name.description: display names, positionally paired with people where the source gives both

text.description: extracted on-device OCR text (screenshots; never sent off-device)
examples:
cargo test -p trove-core
   Compiling trove-core v0.1.0
    Finished test profile

extra.description: everything source-specific (altitude, lens, orientation, file size, ML scene labels, view/fave counts, BeReal front/back file names, hidden flag, …)
